details_en: Brown Cow Cream Top Yogurts are reminiscent of the way yogurt used to be made when rich, smooth cream rose to the top. Temp Tee Whipped Cream Cheese is a classic staple that brings creamy, spreadable goodness to every meal. Uniquely New York since 1927, Temp Tee Whipped Cream Cheese is ideal for bagels, toast, crackers, fresh vegetables and more, making breakfast, snacks and casual meals a little more indulgent. Its soft, airy consistency makes it easy to add to your favorite recipes — from no-bake desserts to savory dips — giving you endless opportunities to enjoy its decadent taste. We do not suggest using Temp Tee Whipped Cream Cheese for baked recipes due to its softer consistency. Temp Tee Whipped Cream Cheese contains no preservatives. Each 11.5-oz cream cheese tub contains about 14 servings. Simply open, spread and savor the creamy richness that has made Temp Tee a trusted name in kitchens for generations. Whether for everyday meals or special occasions, our whipped cream cheese delivers classic flavor, effortless enjoyment and a touch of indulgence in every bite. Keep our tub of cream cheese refrigerated; for best quality, use within 10 days of opening. Do not freeze. Temp Tee Whipped Cream Cheese is proudly Kosher. Contains 80 calories per 2 Tbsp serving. A trusted name in dairy since 1882, Temp Tee has long been a favorite for its rich, velvety texture and versatility.

details_en:
Spring Water
There are over 326 million trillion gallons of water on earth, but only 1 billionth of 1% is crisp and refreshing enough to be called Deer Park. Our water is sourced from springs that span across and around the Eastern Seaboard and beyond.
What Is Spring Water Anyway?
Great question. According to the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): “Spring Water is water derived from an underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.” To be able to label our product as “spring water,” we have to satisfy stringent standards — standards we proudly meet or exceed. That’s why every bottle of Deer Park Brand water is labeled as natural.
When Deer Park Brand Spring Water got its start near the crest of the Appalachians, travelers came from all over to enjoy a taste of the water. Today, our natural spring water comes from carefully selected spring sources in five states. We're still honored to serve folks across the region and call this beautiful place our home.

• 101.4-ounce/3-Liter plastic jug with handle: easy to pour for all your kitchen needs
• Perfect when more water is needed, instead of bringing multiple small bottles
• Spring Water: zero calories, no sweeteners and no artificial colors or flavors
• Contains naturally balanced minerals for a crisp, clean taste
• Every bottle is 100% recyclable (excluding label and cap)
• Water source information may vary depending on bottling facility location. Applicable bottle deposits and/or sales tax may apply.
details_es:
Spring Water
Hay más de 326 millones de trillones de galones de agua en la tierra, pero solo 1 mil millonésima de 1% es lo suficientemente crujiente y refrescante para llamarse Deer Park. Nuestra agua se obtiene de manantiales que se extienden a través y alrededor del Eastern Seaboard y más allá.
¿Qué Es el Spring Water De Todos Modos?
Gran pregunta. Según la U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): "Spring Water es agua derivada de una formación subterránea de la cual el agua fluye naturalmente a la superficie de la tierra en una ubicación identificada". Para poder etiquetar nuestro producto como "spring water", tenemos que satisfacer estándares estrictos — estándares que orgullosamente cumplimos o excedemos. Por eso cada botella de Deer Park Brand water está etiquetada como natural.
Cuando Deer Park Brand Spring Water comenzó cerca de la cresta de los Apalaches, los viajeros venían de todas partes para disfrutar un sabor del agua. Hoy, nuestra spring water natural viene de fuentes de manantial cuidadosamente seleccionadas en cinco estados. Todavía nos sentimos honrados de servir a la gente de toda la región y llamar a este hermoso lugar nuestro hogar.

• Galón plástico de 101.4-onzas/3-Litros con manija: fácil de servir para todas tus necesidades de cocina
• Perfecto cuando se necesita más agua, en lugar de traer múltiples botellas pequeñas
• Spring Water: cero calorías, sin edulcorantes y sin colores ni sabores artificiales
• Contiene minerales naturalmente balanceados para un sabor crujiente y limpio
• Cada botella es 100% reciclable (excluyendo etiqueta y tapa)
• La información de la fuente del agua puede variar dependiendo de la ubicación de la planta embotelladora. Pueden aplicar depósitos de botella y/o impuestos sobre las ventas.

details_en: Polar Seltzer Premium Sparkling Water. Tiny Bubbles: The sparkle sets us apart. We've been perfecting the process of making our signature bubbles, with their long-lasting carbonation and crispness, since 1882. The bubbles are created by carefully dissolving Co2 into water at high pressure and freezing temperatures without exposing the flavors to oxygen. Other people may add sodium or sweeteners to shortcut the road to quality – we do not. Natural Flavors: The taste of our seltzers is defined by the quality ingredients of the ingredients we used. Our approach is to use only the highest-quality, proprietary combinations of flavors and aromas for depth and complexity. These ingredients are extracted and distilled from natural sources (such as lemon peel, lime, mint, etc.) to create highly concentrated “essences”. Relying on copious amounts of these very precious oils, we never skimp when it comes to taste. Triple-Filtered & Locally Sourced Water: Our water is locally sourced and then triple-filtered with our state-of-the-art process to ensure a consistent and authentic Polar Seltzer taste. NO sodium, fluoride, or other funny business added. This is why Polar Seltzer makes for health smart hydration. Family Made Since 1882: Just water, zillions of tiny bubbles, and great taste. Our family has been crafting Polar Seltzer with these same ingredients since 1882. That’s 138 years to perfect what our great-great-grandfather called the world’s best-tasting bubble recipe. At Polar Beverages we work hard to keep things uncomplicated, refreshing and endlessly creative. Take a sip, and let us know.
details_es: Polar Seltzer Premium Sparkling Water. Tiny Bubbles: La efervescencia nos distingue. Hemos estado perfeccionando el proceso de hacer nuestras burbujas características, con su carbonatación duradera y crujiente, desde 1882. Las burbujas se crean disolviendo cuidadosamente Co2 en agua a alta presión y temperaturas de congelación sin exponer los sabores al oxígeno. Otras personas pueden añadir sodio o edulcorantes para tomar atajos al camino de la calidad — nosotros no. Sabores Naturales: El sabor de nuestros seltzers se define por la calidad de los ingredientes que usamos. Nuestro enfoque es usar solo las combinaciones de la más alta calidad y propietarias de sabores y aromas para profundidad y complejidad. Estos ingredientes se extraen y destilan de fuentes naturales (como cáscara de limón, lima, menta, etc.) para crear "esencias" altamente concentradas. Confiando en cantidades copiosas de estos aceites muy preciosos, nunca escatimamos cuando se trata de sabor. Agua Triple-Filtrada y de Origen Local: Nuestra agua se obtiene localmente y luego se triple-filtra con nuestro proceso de vanguardia para asegurar un sabor consistente y auténtico de Polar Seltzer. SIN sodio, fluoruro u otros negocios raros añadidos. Por eso Polar Seltzer es una hidratación inteligente para la salud. Hecho en Familia Desde 1882: Solo agua, zillones de burbujitas y gran sabor. Nuestra familia ha estado elaborando Polar Seltzer con estos mismos ingredientes desde 1882. Eso son 138 años para perfeccionar lo que nuestro tatara-tatara-abuelo llamó la receta de burbujas con mejor sabor del mundo. En Polar Beverages trabajamos duro para mantener las cosas sin complicaciones, refrescantes y sin fin creativas. Toma un sorbo y déjanos saber.

details_en: Savor the goodness of V8 Low Sodium Original 100% Vegetable Juice. A satisfying alternative to other juices, low sodium V8 juice is made with concentrated tomato juice along with the juices of seven other vegetables. The result is a 100% juice with a distinctly rich, savory flavor and 78% less sodium than the original. Delicious and nutritious, V8 vegetable juice is an easy way to help get your daily recommended veggies. Each 8 fl oz serving contains 2 servings of vegetables and is an excellent source of Vitamins A and C. Our veggie juice is also gluten free and non GMO with no sugar added.* Enjoy V8 on its own, over ice, or seasoned with pepper and adorned with your favorite garnishes. It’s great as a breakfast drink, afternoon snack, or post workout drink. In addition to sipping it as a vegetable drink, you can also use V8 low sodium juice to add flavor and nutrition to a variety of dishes. Try it as a vegetable soup base, substitute it for broth in stews, or use it as a marinade. (*Not a low calorie food; see nutrition panel for sugar and calorie content)

details_en: When it comes to fruit juice drinks, nothing compares to Hawaiian Punch. Bursting with the bold taste of tropical fruit flavors, Hawaiian Punch has a fun and delicious taste kids and the whole family can enjoy anytime and anywhere. Convenient and delicious, Hawaiian Punch is the perfect fruit drink when you want a blast of tropical fruit flavor! Hawaiian Punch goes great with snacks or a meal, is perfect for on-the-go, can easily be packed into a lunch box, and can be enjoyed all by itself. Hawaiian Punch is available in flavors Fruit Juicy Red, Polar Blast, Lemon Berry Squeeze, Orange Ocean, Green Berry Rush, Berry Blue Typhoon, Watermelon Berry Boom, Lemonade, Cowabunga Grape, Pineapple Plunge and many more. There is a Hawaiian Punch fruit juice drink flavor for everyone! Hawaiian Punch is caffeine-free, carbonation-free, gluten-free and is an excellent source of Vitamin C. Regálale a tu familia el sabor delicioso y refrescante de Hawaiian Punch. ¡Disfruta la ola de sabor con cada sorbo de Hawaiian Punch!

At Twinings, we take great care to ensure that the Earl Grey you drink today tastes as extraordinary as the one Richard Twining first created, and helps you feel good inside and out . That's why we are excited to bring you the Twinings Lady Grey Citrus Black Tea Bags.  Although it's hard to top an original, our continuous pursuit of a new and unique teas brought forth Lady Grey® tea- a softer, more elegant version of Earl Grey tea developed exclusively for Twinings. To brew the perfect cup, steep one tea bag for 5 minutes in boiling water. At Twinings, we believe in living well and enjoying life. Backed by generations of trusted knowledge and ethical integrity, our Master Blenders are committed to delivering nature’s goodness and ensuring consistent taste and quality by sourcing the world’s finest herbs, fruits, and teas. From traditional teas to functional blends, Twinings encourages consumers to “Drink in Life” by celebrating the small steps that make wellbeing attainable and remain committed to an optimistic life that is well-lived, one sip at a time.

The Story of Celestial Seasonings®
Back in 1969, we started picking herbs from the fields and forests of the Rocky Mountains and in the process, we created America's very first herbal tea. Still blended in Boulder by our expert blendmaster, our uniquely delicious teas are made with the finest ingredients, passion and inspiration.

"This uplifting blend combines spicy ginger—valued for its piquant taste and reputation as a digestive aid—with a cheerfully bright lemon flavor and aroma. You might say that the pairing of lemon and ginger hits 'just the right note' anytime you need a soothing and rejuvenating cup of tea."
Charlie Baden,
Celestial Seasonings Blendmaster

details_en: Choice Organics Tea Earl Grey is a bold and citrusy, elegant black tea made primarily from tea leaves that are grown and harvested at high elevations on the Rukeri tea estate in Rwanda. Known for its temperate climate, abundant rainfall, fertile soil, and lush rolling hills at a high altitude, this region delivers sophisticated teas that are aromatic and full of flavor. We expertly infuse our premium USDA organic certified black tea with bergamot oil for a classic, highly caffeinated tea bag that can be enjoyed straight or with milk and sugar. Choice Organics' bold, flavorful teas are sustainably sourced from around the world for a delicious cup every time.   Bold & Citrusy Earl Grey Tea: Alive with a deliciously zesty aroma, this refreshing black tea celebrates the fragrant, flavorful lushness of bergamot oil. Bold Blend: Delivering an energizing boost, our highly caffeinated (50 mg) Earl Grey black tea makes for a perfect morning cup or an afternoon pick-me-up. Invigorating Black Tea: Sourced from certified organic tea estates around the world, our premium black teas are hand-picked and processed to yield complex teas ranging from light-bodied to full-bodied with brisk flavor profiles. We Care for You and the Planet: Proud to be a B Corp, we source 100% organic and non-GMO ingredients, and our teas are carefully packed in compostable tea bags and recyclable tea boxes in our LEED-certified manufacturing facility. Tea With Intention: Blended to perfection for a full-flavored experience, our organic black, green, herbal, puerh, and oolong tea bags offer something for everyone.
details_es: Choice Organics Tea Earl Grey es un té negro intenso, cítrico y elegante hecho principalmente de hojas de té cultivadas y cosechadas en elevaciones altas en la finca de té Rukeri en Ruanda. Conocida por su clima templado, abundante lluvia, suelo fértil y exuberantes colinas ondulantes en gran altitud, esta región entrega tés sofisticados que son aromáticos y llenos de sabor. Infundimos expertamente nuestro té negro premium certificado orgánico USDA con aceite de bergamota para una bolsita de té clásica y altamente cafeinada que se puede disfrutar directo o con leche y azúcar. Los tés intensos y sabrosos de Choice Organics son obtenidos de forma sostenible de todo el mundo para una taza deliciosa cada vez. Bold & Citrusy Earl Grey Tea: Vivo con un aroma deliciosamente cítrico, este refrescante té negro celebra la exuberancia fragante y sabrosa del aceite de bergamota. Bold Blend: Entregando un empujón energizante, nuestro Earl Grey té negro altamente cafeinado (50 mg) hace una taza perfecta de la mañana o un levantón de la tarde. Invigorating Black Tea: Obtenidos de fincas de té certificadas orgánicas en todo el mundo, nuestros tés negros premium son recogidos a mano y procesados para producir tés complejos que van desde cuerpo ligero hasta cuerpo entero con perfiles de sabor vivos. Nos Importas Tú y el Planeta: Orgullosos de ser B Corp, obtenemos ingredientes 100% orgánicos y non-GMO, y nuestros tés están cuidadosamente empacados en bolsitas compostables y cajas reciclables en nuestra instalación de manufactura certificada LEED. Té con Intención: Mezclados a la perfección para una experiencia llena de sabor, nuestras bolsitas de té orgánico negro, verde, herbal, pu-erh y oolong ofrecen algo para todos.

details_en: Spice up your favorite drinks and dishes with the zesty taste of Clamato, an authentic, invigorating blend flavored with tomato juice and spices. Whether you’re looking for a refreshing juice alternative or want to share the great taste with company, Clamato is the perfect drink for any occasion. Clamato also keeps the party going in the kitchen. Add the hearty, delicious flavor to hot dishes like Pasta Primavera and Shrimp Sauté or cold dishes like Ceviche and Shrimp Cocktails. You can also use it in marinades perfect for grilling seafood, meat, and chicken or make some Spicy Chicken Wings. You even use it to make salsa to dip with chips or spice up tacos! Clamato también mantiene la fiesta en la cocina. Agrega el sabor sustancioso y delicioso a platos calientes como Pasta Primavera y camarones salteados o platos fríos como ceviche y cócteles de camarón. details_en: Ball Park Hot Dogs are as much a summer American tradition as a trip to the ballpark or fireworks on the 4th of July, so you can enjoy the flavor of summer whenever the mood strikes. A chili dog a sprinkling of cheddar cheese and onions? Sure! Wrapped in bacon? Love the gourmet twist! You can even create a hot dog buffet, where everyone will find a combination to love. Whether you're enjoying a classic hot-off-the-grill dog or loading one up Chicago style, Ball Park’s premium hot dogs will always take you back to that authentic taste of summer.

These sweet & savory Alexia classics reveal how sweet potatoes and a hint of sea salt can play the perfect complement to any meal.

Cooking Instructions:
Air Fryer Prep: Preheat air fryer to 360°F. Fill air fryer basket no more than half full. Cook half bag for 10-11 minutes; slide out basket and shake halfway through cooking time.

Oven Prep: Preheat oven to 425°F. Spread frozen potatoes evenly across an 11"x17" lined baking sheet. Bake according to the chart below, turning potatoes over halfway through the baking time. Full Bag: 20-25 minutes. Half Bag: 10-12 minutes.

At Alexia, we think sustaining the earth is a non-negotiable. That's why we continue to invest in green technologies. Our sweet potato production facility is the perfect example - where we convert potato solids into biogas, which, in turn, reduces our use of natural has for energy. As a result, we're home to the first frozen-food production facility ever to earn the esteemed Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED®) Platinum certification. 
 
• Includes one 20 oz. bag of Alexia Sweet Potato Fries Sweet & Savory  with Sea Salt

details_es:

Instrucciones de Cocción:
Preparación en Freidora de Aire: Precalienta la freidora de aire a 360°F. Llena la canasta de la freidora no más de la mitad. Cocina media bolsa por 10-11 minutos; desliza la canasta y agita a la mitad del tiempo de cocción.

Preparación al Horno: Precalienta el horno a 425°F. Extiende las batatas congeladas uniformemente en una bandeja forrada de 11"x17". Hornea según la tabla siguiente, volteando las batatas a la mitad del tiempo de horneado. Bolsa Completa: 20-25 minutos. Media Bolsa: 10-12 minutos.

En Alexia, pensamos que sustentar la tierra es innegociable. Por eso seguimos invirtiendo en tecnologías verdes. Dave's Killer Bread® Rockin' Grains® English Muffins are amped up with killer grains and seeds to rock your world! Each USDA organic English muffin includes 20g of whole grains and features butter-catching flavor craters to create an out-of-this-world breakfast experience. These tasty, Non-GMO Project Verified English muffins are baked with five killer organic grains and seeds, including flax seeds, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, millet and quinoa. Plus, they have no high-fructose corn syrup, no artificial flavors, no artificial ingredients and no bleached flour. You can trust Dave's Killer Bread® to deliver killer taste, texture and whole grain nutrition. Rockin' Grains® English muffins are pre-sliced and just what you need for excellent eggs benedict, hearty breakfast sandwiches or buttery English muffins on the go.

The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Determined to prove his worth and make a positive impact, Dave worked tirelessly to bake breads that tasted unlike anything else on the market — packed with seeds and grains, made with only the very best organic and Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

details_en: Soft & delicious. Traditional recipe. According to legend dating back to the Mayans, tortillas were prepared for noble families and served with every meal. The tortillas played an important role as they were used to scoop or wrap around the other dishes in the meal. The Mayans leave behind a heritage of the tortilla as a convenient and tasty way to wrap an endless variety of fillings across many cultures and cuisines. Mayan Farm tortillas are flavorful, smooth and soft to give you a better quality tortilla. We bake our tortillas with the highest quality, freshest ingredients to create a clean taste and texture that will give you a true tortilla experience.
details_es: Suaves y deliciosas. Receta tradicional. Según la leyenda que data de los Mayas, las tortillas se preparaban para familias nobles y se servían con cada comida. Las tortillas jugaron un rol importante ya que se usaban para recoger o envolver los otros platos en la comida. Los Mayas dejan atrás una herencia de la tortilla como una manera conveniente y sabrosa de envolver una infinita variedad de rellenos a través de muchas culturas y cocinas. Las tortillas Mayan Farm son sabrosas, lisas y suaves para darte una tortilla de mejor calidad. Horneamos nuestras tortillas con los ingredientes más frescos y de la más alta calidad para crear un sabor y textura limpios que te darán una verdadera experiencia de tortilla.

BARILLA Protein+ (Plus) provides a good source of plant-based protein for the whole family—while keeping the classic taste your whole family loves! Made with delicious golden wheat and protein from lentils, chickpeas, and peas, Barilla Protein+ pasta provides a good source of protein for the whole family with 17g of protein per 3.5oz serving. 

Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti is a delicious multigrain pasta made with simple ingredients like semolina and durum wheat as well as protein-rich lentils, peas and chickpeas. A good source of protein, make Protein+ a part of your next healthy, nutritious pasta meal! Protein+ is made with non-GMO ingredients. 

BARILLA Protein Plus pasta cooks just like traditional pasta! Simply boil 4-6 quarts of salted water, add the pasta and boil for 7-9 minutes. We love to cook our pasta for 7 minutes, but you can add 1-2 extra minutes for more tender pasta.

details_en: Taste the traditional flavor of Ragú Old World Style Parmesan & Romano Pasta Sauce. It's Nonna approved! A great option for family dinner, Ragú Old World tomato sauce is made from an authentic recipe with high quality ingredients. details_en:
Start your day off right with Nestlé® Nesquik® Chocolate Syrup, just add two teaspoons to an eight-ounce glass of low-fat milk and stir for a cold, sweet and nostalgic chocolate milk. This twenty-two-ounce bottle has about thirty-one servings of Nesquik® Syrup that can be added to milk, your favorite dairy alternative, or poured on ice cream like chocolate sauce for an epic sundae. Any way you sweeten up your day, you can feel good about using Nesquik® chocolate syrup with no artificial sweeteners, flavors, colors*, or high fructose corn syrup. So go ahead, squeeze, stir, and spark some greatness with a sip. *Added colors from natural sources

• SIP GREATNESS: With classic Nesquik® Chocolate Syrup, you can enjoy sweet chocolate milk that makes every sip great — any time of day!
• LEVEL-UP YOUR DAIRY: Transform your dairy (and plant-based alternatives) into delicious chocolate milk or add Nesquik® syrup to your lineup of ice cream sundae bar supplies
• TASTE OF NOSTALGIA: A family staple since the eighties, Nesquik® chocolate syrup has that beloved flavor and sweetness, perfect for making kids, or your inner kid, smile big
• DELICIOUS FUN: We believe good choices can come with a splash of fun, that’s why we’re continuously working to make our syrups, powders, and other products more nutritious 
• QUICK AS A BUNNY: Make chocolate milk fast anytime you want a sweet treat by adding two teaspoons to eight ounces of low-fat milk. This bottle of Nesquik® syrup contains about thirty-one servings
• WHAT’S NOT INSIDE: You won’t find any high fructose corn syrup, artificial sweeteners, flavors or colors* in Nesquik® chocolate syrup, perfect for making a sweet and delicious glass of chocolate milk *Added colors from natural sources
details_es:

Esta botella de veintidós onzas tiene aproximadamente treinta y una porciones de Nesquik® Syrup que se pueden añadir a la leche, tu alternativa láctea favorita, o verter sobre helado como salsa de chocolate para un sundae épico. Sin importar cómo endulzas tu día, puedes sentirte bien usando el sirope de chocolate Nesquik® sin edulcorantes artificiales, sabores, colores* ni jarabe de maíz de alta fructosa. Así que adelante, exprime, revuelve y enciende un poco de grandeza con un sorbo. *Colores añadidos de fuentes naturales

• SORBE GRANDEZA: Con el clásico Nesquik® Chocolate Syrup, puedes disfrutar una leche chocolatada dulce que hace cada sorbo genial — ¡en cualquier momento del día!
• SUBE DE NIVEL TUS LÁCTEOS: Transforma tus lácteos (y alternativas a base de plantas) en una deliciosa leche chocolatada o añade el sirope Nesquik® a tu línea de suministros para la barra de sundaes de helado
• SABOR A NOSTALGIA: Un básico familiar desde los ochenta, el sirope de chocolate Nesquik® tiene ese sabor y dulzura querido, perfecto para hacer sonreír a los niños, o al niño interior
• DIVERSIÓN DELICIOSA: Creemos que las buenas elecciones pueden venir con un toque de diversión, por eso trabajamos continuamente para hacer nuestros siropes, polvos y otros productos más nutritivos 
• RÁPIDO COMO UN CONEJITO: Haz leche chocolatada rápido cuando quieras un gustito dulce añadiendo dos cucharaditas a ocho onzas de leche baja en grasa. Esta botella de sirope Nesquik® contiene aproximadamente treinta y una porciones
• LO QUE NO ESTÁ ADENTRO: No encontrarás jarabe de maíz de alta fructosa, edulcorantes, sabores o colores artificiales* en el sirope de chocolate Nesquik®, perfecto para hacer un vaso dulce y delicioso de leche chocolatada *Colores añadidos de fuentes naturales

• Potato Starch is a white powder similar in texture to cornstarch.
 
• Often used along with or to replace wheat flour as the base for breads and cakes.
 
• Potato Starch is extracted from potatoes.
 
• Soups and sauces that contain Potato Starch will end up having a glossier, silkier mouthfeel.
details_es:

Añade humedad a los productos horneados y es un ingrediente esencial en la repostería sin gluten. 
 
• Potato Starch es un polvo blanco similar en textura al cornstarch.

In 1946, during the post-war boom of innovation and industry, Niles Foster set his sights on the market for convenient fruit based beverages. What captured his imagination was the idea of an orange drink, bubbly and bright, that would appeal to families seeking vitamins alongside refreshment. It needed to have a balance of tangy citrus and sweet flavors and possess the genuine nutrition of natural Vitamin C, the ingredient that earned the drink its name—Hi-C––because of its high content of Vitamin C compared to competing juices. The drink was immediately a hit in the south and in just a decade became a nationwide success. Over the years a variety of flavors have been added to the Hi-C portfolio.

En 1946, durante el boom de la posguerra de innovación e industria, Niles Foster puso sus ojos en el mercado de bebidas convenientes a base de fruta. Lo que capturó su imaginación fue la idea de una bebida de naranja, burbujeante y brillante, que apelaría a las familias que buscaban vitaminas junto con refrigerio. Necesitaba tener un balance de sabores cítricos fuertes y dulces y poseer la nutrición genuina de Vitamina C natural, el ingrediente que le ganó a la bebida su nombre — Hi-C — debido a su alto contenido de Vitamina C comparado con jugos competidores. Stove top cooking instructions: 1. Place the desired amount of frozen vegetables in a small amount (1/2 to 1 cup) of boiling water. 2. Bring the water rapidly to a second boil. Cover the pan and reduce heat. 3. Cook gently for 7 to 9 minutes or until tender. Avoid overcooking.
nf23596
microwave cooking instructions: 1. Place frozen vegetables in a 2-quart microwave safe casserole dish with good fitting cover. 2. Add 2 tablespoons of water and cook on high setting for 3 minutes. 3. Stir the vegetables and cook on high for an additional 5 to 7 minutes. 4. Allow the casserole to stand for 2 minutes after cooking before opening. Microwave cooking times vary with ovens - avoid over cooking. Cook to 165°f for quality and food safety.

Instrucciones para cocinar en estufa: 1. Coloca la cantidad deseada de vegetales congelados en una pequeña cantidad (1/2 a 1 taza) de agua hirviendo. 2. Lleva el agua rápidamente a un segundo hervor. Tapa la sartén y reduce el fuego. 3. Cocina suavemente por 7 a 9 minutos o hasta que esté tierno. Evita sobrecocinar.
nf23596
instrucciones para cocinar en microondas: 1. Coloca los vegetales congelados en un plato para cazuela apto para microondas de 2 cuartos con una tapa bien ajustada. 2. Añade 2 cucharadas de agua y cocina a alta potencia por 3 minutos. 3. Revuelve los vegetales y cocina a alta potencia por 5 a 7 minutos adicionales. 4. Deja reposar la cazuela por 2 minutos después de cocinar antes de abrir. Los tiempos de cocción en microondas varían con los hornos - evita sobrecocinar. Cocina a 165°f para calidad y seguridad alimentaria.

Microwave cooking instructions: 1. Stand package upright (or lay face down) in microwave oven. Do not puncture package. 2. Microwave on high for 5 to 6 minutes. During cooking, the bag will slowly inflate. Special vents in the bag will allow the steam to escape while cooking. Steam should escape from fully inflated bag for about 30 seconds. Cook until heated thoroughly (165°f) but avoid overcooking. 3. Let bag stand for 2 minutes before opening. Carefully handle bag at corners and shake gently to mix. Tear or cut the top of the bag open. Pour contents out and mix well. Enjoy! Microwave cooking times vary with ovens- avoid over/under cooking.

Instrucciones para cocinar en microondas: 1. Para el paquete en posición vertical (o acuéstalo boca abajo) en el horno microondas. No perfores el paquete. 2. Calienta en el microondas a alta potencia por 5 a 6 minutos. Durante la cocción, la bolsa se inflará lentamente. Ventilaciones especiales en la bolsa permitirán que el vapor escape mientras cocina. El vapor debe escapar de la bolsa completamente inflada por aproximadamente 30 segundos. Cocina hasta calentar completamente (165°f) pero evita sobrecocinar. 3. Deja reposar la bolsa por 2 minutos antes de abrir. Maneja con cuidado la bolsa por las esquinas y agítala suavemente para mezclar. Rasga o corta la parte superior de la bolsa para abrir. details_en: Radiators, Radiatore in Italian, are a relatively modern pasta shape that was created around the mid-20th Century and inspired by the structure of radiators found in many Italian homes. The unique design of Radiatore makes it excellent at capturing and holding onto sauces. The ridges and deep grooves on its surface provide ample surface area for thick, chunky sauces to cling to, while the hollow, dense structure allows for sauces to nestle inside, ensuring each bite is flavorful.
details_es: Radiators, Radiatore en italiano, es una forma de pasta relativamente moderna que se creó a mediados del siglo XX e inspirada en la estructura de los radiadores que se encuentran en muchos hogares italianos. El diseño único de Radiatore lo hace excelente para capturar y retener salsas. Las crestas y surcos profundos en su superficie proporcionan amplia área de superficie para que las salsas espesas y chunky se aferren, mientras que la estructura hueca y densa permite que las salsas se aniden dentro, asegurando que cada bocado sea sabroso.

Una mezcla robusta de ajo, chiles de árbol y piquín, y las especias características de Cholula® Hot Sauce para animar la noche de tacos. Nuestro Chili Garlic Taco Seasoning Mix hace auténticos tacos mexicanos de filete que son suaves en picante para agradar a toda la familia.

Hecho con ajo, cebolla y una mezcla balanceada de especias y chiles, este sabor para tacos es versátil. Usa el relleno de filete en burritos, enchiladas o tacos de desayuno. Para una noche de tacos inspirada en mariscos, prueba el condimento con 1 lb. de camarones pelados o filetes de tilapia. También es un excelente condimento de chili o una forma fácil de añadir sabor de chili-garlic a queso dip. Cholula es la marca que conoces y en la que confías para traerte comidas que celebran sus raíces mexicanas.
